0022600003.text: The San Antonio Spurs host the Oklahoma City Thunder in a game that opens the 2026-27 season for both teams, since neither has played yet. Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out for the Spurs, while Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) is out for the Thunder and Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jaylin Williams, Nikola Topic and Thomas Sorber are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The Spurs won the 2025-26 regular season series 4-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-3, including a 111-103 win in Oklahoma City on May 30, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Spurs a 55% chance to win.
